summary.text: Dave Bronson is a Republican, a retired Air National Guard lieutenant colonel and commercial pilot who served as mayor of Anchorage from 2021 to 2024 and later managed Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport.
He supports a constitutional amendment mandating Permanent Fund dividends by the pre-2017 formula and describes data centers as an economic opportunity.

paragraphs.text: Bronson was born and raised in Superior, Wisconsin, and earned a B.S. in agricultural economics from the University of Wisconsin–Madison.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1981 to 1990 and in the Alaska Air National Guard from 1993 to 2005, retiring as a lieutenant colonel, and has worked as a commercial pilot since 1990.
Bronson won the Anchorage mayor's office in a May 2021 runoff and served until 2024, when he lost re-election to Suzanne LaFrance.
In January 2025, Gov. Mike Dunleavy appointed him to manage Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport, and he announced his resignation from that job in August 2025.
He announced his run for governor on October 2, 2025.
The Alaska Beacon describes him as an experienced pilot.
